title: GET <hosts.<name>.url> — `beacon serve`'s one response (version 1)
$comment: Body bytes change only when a check's status or message changes, so ETag/304 hold between changes (ADR D4). The CLI writes exactly this; the app ignores unknown fields (ADR D1).

checks.description: Keyed by check id. A check that has not finished its first run is absent.

message.description: Last non-empty line of stdout+stderr, or `timeout after <n>s`.
